screening: Nine validation-only evaluations, three variants x three source seeds. Select ONE variant by mean validation AP50-95; no test metrics read.
recovery: Selected variant and uncompressed CTPA each receive 200 additional supervised train-only epochs per seed, same optimizer/data/augmentations. Fresh AdamW1e-4, warmup_bias_lr1e-4, cosine lrf.01, batch8,640,patience0. Original lowrank initial checkpoint and original teacher remain eligible if continued training does not improve validation fitness.
selection: Best within-run checkpoint from validation .1AP50+.9AP50-95; then choose initial versus recovered checkpoint by the same FP32 validation fitness. Freeze all six final choices before a single final test phase. No subsequent test-directed search.
scope: New compressed-CTPA variant, not the historical SharedFormer implementation. SVD and low-rank factorization are established methods; no novelty or accuracy guarantee. Source teachers were already trained200epochs; report both teacher training and additional recovery cost. Existing source test previously inspected, so any later confirmation remains exploratory.
main_goal: Fewer parameters than both historical SF and CTPA; seek validation gains over both. Validation gains alone do not prove held-out-test improvement.
